description: This file defines the class 'GenericOAuthProviderConnector', which extends 'ExternalOAuthProviderConnector', and provides methods related to OAuth provider integration, specifically for the Microsoft provider, including token mapping functionalities.

classes.name: GenericOAuthProviderConnector
classes.description: A connector class for handling OAuth provider interactions, specifically for Microsoft in this context. Implements token mapping logic and provider type identification.

methods.name: getProviderType
methods.description: Returns the type of OAuth provider, here 'Microsoft'.

methods.name: mapAccessToken
methods.description: Maps an AccessTokenInterface object to an array of token data, using dynamic mapping if available, otherwise default token details.
